description:
Outcome: Support the shared waiting -> being helped -> finished queue required by BRIEF.md.
Scope: Validate first name/item, apply agreed ordering, atomically select next visitor, finish active repairs, implement agreed durability/retention and retry identities. Excludes: UI and SMS.
Acceptance: Concurrent claims never assign the same visitor; retrying a successful claim after a lost response recovers the original assignment rather than taking another visitor; invalid transitions do not mutate state; empty queue has a defined result; restart and retention follow checkpoint decisions.
Behaviour: Explicit validation, empty and conflict results; recoverable retry behaviour.
Verification: Domain/storage tests for transitions, concurrency, lost responses, restart and retention. Prerequisites: T-002 and T-003. Assumptions: storage technology and domain choices are unresolved until the owner checkpoint and implementation planning.
title: Implement queue lifecycle and storage
